facts.fact: To correct a wrongly printed name on the voter ID, apply in Form 8
facts.quote: You can make an application in Form 8 for rectification of the errors in your EPIC.

facts.fact: After correction the ERO issues a new EPIC with the same number
facts.quote: The Electoral Registration Officer will issue a new EPIC, with the same number, after making the necessary corrections.

summary: Confirmed in ECI's electoral roll FAQ: Form 8, new EPIC with the same number.
